data.name: Mustafaa
data.gender_notes: Mustafaa is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is highly praised and commended by Allah, a title given to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Mustafaa carries the meaning “Praiseworthy, Commended” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mustafaa usually hope their child will grow to embody praiseworthy, commended and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is guided and blessed by Allah, a true follower of the Quran and the Sunnah.
data.etymology: Mustafaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praiseworthy, Commended.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mustafaa total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mustafa" or "Musa'ab" in Arabic means "chosen one" and is a name given to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) by Allah Himself. It emphasizes the significance of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) being the beloved and chosen Messenger of Allah, and highlights the importance of following his teachings and example as a model of good character and conduct for Muslims around the world.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Mustafa" holds great spiritual significance as it serves as a constant reminder of the Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) special connection and closeness to Allah. It inspires Muslims to strive for a deeper relationship with Allah and to model their lives after the Prophet's example of obedience, humility, and devotion. The name also emphasizes the importance of being chosen by Allah for a specific purpose or mission in life and reminds believers to be grateful for Allah's blessings and guidance.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Praiseworthy, Commended" symbolizes One who is highly praised and commended by Allah, a title given to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mustafaa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of praiseworthy, commended.
